entry.title: Larkspur AI releases an open-weight reasoning model
entry.summary: The 70-billion-parameter model matches proprietary systems on coding benchmarks and ships under the Apache 2.0 license.

entry.title: Rust nightly turns on parallel compilation by default
entry.summary: The change makes the compiler's long-awaited parallel front end the default for nightly users.

entry.title: EU begins enforcing transparency rules for AI chatbots
entry.summary: Chatbots offered in the EU must now tell users they are talking to an AI, and regulators can fine companies that do not.

entry.title: Survival game Rust adds a winter map and new vehicles
entry.summary: The monthly update brings snowmobiles and a frozen-lake biome to the multiplayer game.

entry.title: Foldable phone with a week-long battery goes on sale
entry.summary: The phone's new silicon-carbon battery lasts seven days in the maker's own tests.

entry.title: Hospital network deploys an AI triage assistant in emergency rooms
entry.summary: Nurses review the assistant's suggested priority for each patient; waits fell during a six-month pilot.

entry.title: Automotive chip shortage eases as a new fab opens in Arizona
entry.summary: The plant makes microcontrollers for car makers, easing shortages that idled assembly lines.

entry.title: Startup raises $40 million to train coding models
entry.summary: The two-year-old company plans to open a research office in Toronto.
